intro: What the taskbar shows and how it behaves: alignment, search, the buttons Windows adds, the system tray, and behavior across multiple displays.

groups.Layout: Clean Taskbar removes every app pinned to the taskbar.
groups.Taskbar Icons: The search box and the buttons Windows puts on the taskbar: Task View, Widgets, News and Interests, the Copilot buttons, Recall and Meet Now.
groups.Taskbar Behavior: Alignment, auto-hide, badges and flashing, combined buttons, system tray icons, seconds on the clock, transparency and size, multiple displays, and End Task on the right-click menu.
